end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from its source.
Compared nearby and distant foods using kilometres and food miles.
Explained that longer distances can use more fuel and cause more pollution.
Explained extra cooling, ice, electricity and packaging needs for strawberries.
Teach-back was not passed; one comparison was correct without help.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles and comparing foods by travel distance. They explained the links between longer journeys, fuel use, pollution, freshness, cooling, electricity and packaging. They first mentioned cooling costs, then clarified the role of electricity or ice and extra packaging; the main mix-up was resolved later. At home, ask them to compare two foods and say which has fewer food miles and why.
